about: The centre shared by both full fixtures: one university tutoring and writing centre in New York. Its settings, services, skills, tutors and weekly timetable are the same for every student; scripts/build-fixtures.cjs turns the timetable into the open slots of the two weeks in slot_window and adds the past slots each student's history uses. The math skills are Milepost's Algebra 1 and Introductory Statistics skills, with the same IDs and titles (apps/milepost/fixtures/catalog/courses.json in PR #70, at 5636409), so a task can load both Apps for the same student; the writing skills are Tutorwell's own.

services.title: Math and statistics tutoring
services.description: One-to-one help with algebra and statistics coursework: bring the problems you are stuck on.

services.title: Writing centre
services.description: One-to-one feedback on a draft you bring, at any stage: essays, lab reports and project write-ups.
